rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone drunk and staggering from alcohol.

example.english: After a few beers, they were rolling drunk on the way home.
example.traditional: 佢飲完幾杯啤酒，醉醺醺咁行返屋企。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jam2 jyun4 gei2 bui1 be1 zau2 zeoi3 fan1 fan1 gam3 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei5

rows.note: Use this for land or hills that rise and fall in gentle undulations.

example.english: The hills over there are rolling and beautiful.
example.traditional: 嗰邊啲山起伏連綿，幾靚㗎。
example.jyutping: go2 bin1 di1 saan1 hei2 fuk6 lin4 min4 gei2 leng3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when something moves by turning over and over, especially in descriptive or technical contexts.

example.english: The ball kept rolling down the slope and would not stop.
example.traditional: 個波沿住斜路一路滾動，停唔到。
example.jyutping: go3 bo1 jyun4 zyu6 ce4 lou6 jat1 lou6 gwan2 dung6 ting4 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when work or events are arranged in separate batches rather than all at once.

example.english: The new stock will arrive in rolling deliveries, so we will not have to wait for everything at once.
example.traditional: 新貨會分批送到，唔使一次過等晒。
example.jyutping: san1 fo3 wui5 fan1 pai1 sung3 dou3 m4 sai2 jat1 ci3 gwo3 dang2 saai3
